notes.title: Version 1.1 Live
notes.notes:
Today we have posted a new update for Animal Cafe, due to some requests and also general feedback on the game, a variety of minor adjustments have been made to the game to add some additional transitions between some of the adult scenes so that they are less 'jarring'.

In addition Animal Cafe is now available for PC, Mac and Linux and is confirmed Steam Deck compatible.
